description: Formats and lints each edited file with the project's own tools.

formatters.description: The formatters to run on each edited file: prettier or biome, and ruff. init records the ones it detects.

linters.description: The linters to run on each edited file: eslint and ruff. init records the ones it detects.

commands.description: Extra checks to run on each edited file, as argument arrays its path is appended to, such as ["node", "scripts/check.mjs"].
